### The Kingdom of God (Luke 17:21) - Your Daily Bible Verse - November 24
Author: Amanda Idleman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/your-daily-bible-verse-november-24.html
Passage: Luke 17:21
Points:
- Believers often exhaust themselves searching for special formulas, books, or emotional highs to experience God.
- Experiencing God's presence does not require complex routines because accepting Jesus makes us part of His family.
- The kingdom of God represents His reign, which is already active in believers' hearts while also awaiting final consummation.
- The Pharisees missed the Messiah standing right before them because of their rigid preconceptions about what His kingdom should look like.
- Believers are urged to keep open hearts so they do not miss how God is moving in unexpected ways around them.

### Sunday Reflection: The Promise of His Kingdom
Author: In Touch Ministries
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/sunday-reflection-the-promise-of-his-kingdom
Passage: Luke 17:21
Points:
- Scripture presents the kingdom of God as both a present reality to experience and a future promise yet to be completed.
- God's kingdom is far more than a physical location; it is His sovereign reign across all eternity.
- Jesus taught that the kingdom is already in our midst, actively drawing people to Himself through His redeeming love.
- Believers can live with confident hope knowing that Christ will one day return and make all things new.
- Daily life is transformed when Christians recognize God at work within their personal lives and in the surrounding world.
